# GeoNames

`src/SpeedForge.Core/city-locations.json` contains a subset of city coordinates derived from GeoNames `cities15000.zip`, retrieved 12 October 2026. Original names are matched to the application's server catalog; population is used to resolve name collisions. Each record retains its GeoNames ID.

Source: https://download.geonames.org/export/dump/cities15000.zip
Data format and attribution: https://download.geonames.org/export/dump/readme.txt
License: Creative Commons Attribution 4.0, https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/
Attribution: GeoNames, https://www.geonames.org/

Coordinates describe city centres, not verified server-building positions. Entries without a known city are excluded from geographic ranking. GeoIP estimates are approximate and may reflect a VPN endpoint.
